title: When CONTRIBUTING Files Fall Short: Revising OSS Contribution Guidelines with Repository Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2610.21316v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contribution guidelines help newcomers participate in open-source software projects, yet often contain incomplete or outdated information. Existing studies characterize newcomers' information needs and documentation gaps, but revising these guidelines requires recovering and validating project-specific knowledge from scattered sources. We present ContribAlign, a framework for automatically revising CONTRIBUTING files through category-guided evidence integration. A qualitative analysis yields a taxonomy of 30 fine-grained guidance types across six contribution categories. ContribAlign uses a classifier to diagnose coverage of the six categories in the original guidance, then uses the taxonomy to collect and organize project-specific evidence. It filters detected conflicts and uses a large language model to generate category-level revisions. The classifier achieves a weighted F1 score of 0.764, improving on the existing classifier by 0.156

translated_title: 当CONTRIBUTING文件存在不足时：基于仓库证据修订开源软件贡献指南
translated_abstract: 贡献指南帮助新手参与开源软件项目，但往往包含不完整或过时的信息。现有研究刻画了新手的信息需求和文档缺口，但修订这些指南需要从分散的来源中恢复和验证项目特定的知识。我们提出了ContribAlign，一个通过类别引导的证据整合来自动修订CONTRIBUTING文件的框架。一项定性分析得出了涵盖六个贡献类别的30种细粒度指导类型的分类体系。ContribAlign使用分类器诊断原始指导内容对六个类别的覆盖情况，然后利用该分类体系收集并组织项目特定的证据。它过滤检测到的冲突，并使用大语言模型生成类别级别的修订内容。该分类器达到了0.764的加权F1分数，比现有分类器提升了0.156。
tldr: 提出ContribAlign框架，基于涵盖六大贡献类别的30种细粒度指导类型分类体系，利用分类器诊断CONTRIBUTING文件的覆盖缺口，并整合仓库证据过滤冲突后由大语言模型自动生成修订内容。
en_tdlr: ContribAlign automatically revises OSS CONTRIBUTING files by using a classifier to diagnose coverage gaps across a 30-type fine-grained guidance taxonomy, integrating repository evidence to filter conflicts, and generating category-level revisions with a large language model.
